text.heroSubtitle: Kathak classes for kids and adults, online and at the Kendra.
text.aboutText: Sangeet Manjari Kala Kendra is a home for Kathak, the storytelling dance of North India. We teach in the guru–shishya way – footwork, spins, gestures and expression, with the music and taal behind them – so every student dances with confidence and understanding.
text.guruBio: Akshita Sharma – Doordarshan B Grade Kathak artist with Visharad, Nipun and Bhaskar qualifications in Kathak.

guru.name: Akshita Sharma
guru.title: Founder & Kathak Guru · Kathak Artist & Vocalist
guru.bio: Akshita Sharma is a Kathak artist and vocalist from Jaipur with about nine years of training in Kathak, alongside Hindustani classical vocal music and tabla. She founded Sangeet Manjari Kala Kendra to teach Kathak in a structured, traditional way – building both practical skill and theoretical understanding – and prepares students for grade examinations. She has a deep interest in Indian cultural heritage, temple art and architecture, and how music and dance have evolved over time.
credentials: B Grade Artist in Kathak – Doordarshan Kendra, Jaipur
Visharad & Nipun in Kathak – Bhatkhande Sangeet Vidyapeeth, Lucknow
Bhaskar, Advanced Diploma in Kathak – Pracheen Kala Kendra, Chandigarh
M.A. in Vocal Music (pursuing) – University of Rajasthan, Jaipur
Diploma in Tabla (Madhyama Part I cleared) – Bhatkhande Sangeet Vidyapeeth
guru.trainedUnder: Trained in Kathak under Dr. Swati Agarwal and Shri Jay Karan Kawa Ji, in vocal music under Dr. Shekhar Saxena, and in tabla under Dr. R. D. Agarwal.
